name: soroban-anchor-gate
description: SorobanAnchor Gate - Milestone Escrow & Stellar Anchor Bridge Monorepo

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:web && npm run install:client && npm run install:contracts && npm run install:relay
scripts.dev: concurrently --names web,relay --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:relay"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:client && npm run build:web && npm run build:relay
scripts.build:relay: cd services/relay && go build -o relay cmd/relay/main.go
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:client && npm run test:web && npm run test:relay
scripts.lint: npm run lint:contracts && npm run lint:client && npm run lint:web && npm run lint:relay
scripts.lint:contracts: cd contracts && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.lint:web: cd apps/web && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/web/node_modules apps/web/.next packages/contract-client/node_modules packages/contract-client/dist contracts/target services/relay/relay

author: Sorobo-Gate
